description: Get alerts in a Telegram chat, group or channel, through your own bot.
fields.botToken.label: Bot token
fields.chatId.label: Chat id
fields.chatId.help: Detected automatically. A group has a negative id, a public channel can be written @name.
fields.includeImages.label: Include images
fields.includeImages.help: Sends the product photo with the alert.
fields.silent.label: Silent notifications
guide.botfather.title: Open Telegram and talk to @BotFather
guide.botfather.description: BotFather is Telegram's official bot for creating your own bot. Open it on your phone or computer.
guide.newbot.title: Create your bot
guide.newbot.description: Send the command below to BotFather, then pick a name (anything) and a username ending in "bot", for example mystock_bot.
guide.token.title: Paste the bot token
guide.token.description: BotFather replies with a token. Paste it here: we check that it works. Keep it secret, it gives control of your bot.
guide.chat.title: Send /start to your bot
guide.chat.description: Open your bot and send it /start, then click "Detect". For a group: add the bot to the group and write a message there. For a channel: add the bot as an administrator and post a message.
guide.test.title: Send a test message
guide.test.description: We send a test message to the chosen chat. Check that you received it before saving the channel.
errors.invalidToken: This token does not look right. It looks like 123456789:AAH… (copy all of it from BotFather).
errors.tokenRejected: Telegram rejects this token. Check that it is complete, or create a new one with /token in BotFather.
errors.webhookSet: This bot uses a webhook, so automatic detection is not possible. Type the chat id by hand, or remove the webhook.
